'''Emiliano González Arqués''' (born 20 September 1969) is a retired [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[Forward (association football)|striker]]. Born and raised in Spain, he moved to Andorra at 21, when he was signed by [[FC Andorra]], and ultimately became a naturalised citizen of Andorra and represented the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]]. He earned 37<ref>{{cite web |title=Emiliano González Arqués |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=7016 |website=eu-football.info |access-date=16 September 2025}}</ref> international caps between 1998 and 2003.
